title: Bardo Rogue
subtitle: Gauntlet against Enter the Gungeon & Hades — Phase 0 repair, then wave 1

timeline.text: Goal armed. Inventoryed the Kenney vertical slice.
Baseline captured. First piece: The Threshold (arena first look).
Round 1 build in — lighting, grade, ritual floor, living air.
Blind critic lane blocked (billing). Same unlabeled stills read here: the bar won.
NOT YET. Biggest gap: stock Kenney box with a ring on dirt vs an authored chamber (plate, carpets, furniture).
Round 2 in — seal plate, nave, side aisles, wall furniture, side braziers.
R2 still lost: tan dirt + HUD-reticle seal. Approach change — opaque plate, floor wash, no ticks.
Round 3 in — slate floor, gold seal + chevron, purple diamond rugs, graves/chest/table, wall windows.
Round 4 build — original bardo_room tileset. Kenney leaves the floor.
R4 recaptured: flagstones, purple runners, steel plate + chevron, tall planters, velvet benches, window lights.
Blind critic picked the bar. Gap: lighting pass over a brick-banner kit vs a furnished place with a signature inlay.
Round 5 in — still pool in the steel plate, ash-leaf planters, velvet armchairs. Banner kit stripped.
Round 6 in — aisles packed with plants, well-lip on the pool, hotter window lights. Critic on the still.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: tiled layout dressed with identical plants vs an interior with materials, motifs, a memorable center.
Round 7 in — star well + broken ring, three plant kinds, richer runners.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: schematic tiles and a graphic hole vs material weight, shadow, lived-in density.
Round 8 in — raised well lip, contact shadows under every prop. Still building.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: dim brick box + portal sticker vs furniture mass, contrasting materials, a thematic floor.
Round 9 in — 32px plants and chairs, wine runners, brass threshold inlay, north counters. Critic on the still.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: prefab lobby with a crest vs a furnished interior built around one architectural object.
Round 10 in — Keep-light walls, bigger steel plate, quieter door. Furniture can actually be named in the wide shot.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: tiled kit in bilateral symmetry, no lighting hierarchy, no authored monument.
Round 11 in — carved dais with relief threshold, restored vignette, slight furniture asymmetry.
Blind critic still on the bar. Gap: brick box of grid-snapped props and flat light vs materials, volume, a floor you remember.
STOP on arena-first-look after 11 rounds, 0 passes. Four audits agree the root cause is not the builder: no art direction to aim at, and a 60 Hz game judged on stills.
Verified all four audits against the live repo. 8 claims confirmed. 2 already stale: camera lookahead IS dt-corrected (camera.ts:24) and the gamepad deadzone IS already radial.
Struck the automated gate that demanded a 60-120s clear. Measured 37.8-43.3s. The only ways to pass were HP inflation or filler waves, both banned by the vision. Replaced with a variance gate.

Attack is now a true edge on keyboard, mouse and gamepad. Holding the button no longer plays the combo for you. Aim goes through the inverse world transform, so shake and zoom can no longer move your cursor.
Harness repaired: live metrics getter, widened state hash, visual/gameplay RNG split, pool-overflow telemetry, restart replay parity. 35 tests green, was 18.

The RNG split alone fixed the 'solved room'. kite/full clear spread 5.5s -> 8.9s; damage taken went from 4 on every seed to [2,4,1,3,3,3,4,2]. Zero variance was a coupling bug, not a wave-design problem.
pnpm strip ships: tick-labelled motion strips with state, events and freeze marked. Nine timing pieces went from unjudgeable to judgeable.
ART_DIRECTION.md ships, 533 lines with an acceptance test. The arena piece stays PARKED until it can be cited section by section instead of guessed at.
Caught a gate of my own that was as unmeasured as the one I struck: dodge success measured 0.03, not the asserted 0.6-0.8. Replaced with direct measurement of roll speed against run speed.
Found 29 Math.random calls in the render layer: the same strip captured twice differs. Giving presentation its own seeded generator, or every round-over-round diff is noise.

pieces.title: Live metrics, wide hash, RNG split, overflow telemetry, replay parity
Per-entity view split so six lanes run in parallel
Seeded presentation RNG so captures reproduce
Feel lane 2/3 — light hits move the camera 0.19px; two reward channels are dead code
Feel lane 3/3 — the roll is 54% faster than running
Readability is colour memory, not geometry
Bolt-cutting is the best idea in the combat and the least rewarded
Red tell lasts ~147ms; four chargers read as four identical blinks
Banners desync from sim time; no gamepad glyphs
'YOU DIED / press R' over an indigo death-realm, under a fighter-game announcer
One master bus, no loop flag, ambience literally cannot play
PARKED after 11 losses. Re-enters only behind the art bible and an authored asset kit.
